text.p: These are the leading stories in the Lebanese press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Stormy debate delays Constitutional Council rulings on appeals against results of last summer's parliamentary elections.
- Lebanon ceasefire monitoring committee mulls Lebanese and Israeli complaints.
- Foreign Minister Bouez says Arabs need to hold a summit.
- Iranian Foreign Minister Velayati in Beirut next week.
- Solidere Global Depository Receipts soar to $17.625.
- The government might reconsider extending parliament's mandate by eight months.
- Yields on Lebanese treasury bills stabilise.
- Opposition General Labour Confederation chief Abu Rizk: "We will accept judicial ruling on the legality of our elections."
- Arab Capital Markets Conference begins in Beirut on May 21.
- Israeli shelling of south Lebanon areas.
